summary: Backend-only validation for cloned Transpetro admin panel. All 17 tests passed covering admin auth (login success/401, /me with/without token), dashboard KPIs/funnel/activity/realtime, settings GET/PUT with persistence check, PIX end-to-end (generate + qr.png + code.txt), tracking (access + registration), CEP lookup, and admin list. Settings persistence verified (pix_key round-trip). PIX generation works after settings are configured.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is large (>1400 lines) - candidate for splitting into modular routers (auth, dashboard, settings, pix, tracking) for maintainability.
PIX endpoints /api/pix/qr.png and /api/pix/code.txt are unauthenticated - acceptable for public payment display but confirm intended by product.
seed_data_creation: Settings PUT set pix_key=test@pix.com, pix_nome=TEST NOME, pix_cidade=SAO PAULO, valor_inscricao=120.00. Main agent may want to reset these to production values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 backend endpoints from the review request are green against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_review_endpoints.py is reusable regression suite. Note that TestSettings.test_update_settings overwrites live settings with TEST values.
